title: Show HN: Watch weight-space programming in action with WebGPU
summary: I wanted to build a full weight-space programming loop entirely in the browser with WebGPU: let an LLM inspect Qwen3.5-0.8B, edit its weights, evaluate, and repeat. the full loop needed too much VRAM.

key_insights: LLM分析不可用，已使用默认结果。
